expected_outcomes_note: Expected admission outcomes are NOT recorded in this manifest, by design, for the main set and for the mutations alike. They are pre-declared in engine/ADMISSION-PREREGISTRATION.md. Every field under "observed" was read from the file's own bytes with pyarrow, or, for the tail facts, from the raw last eight bytes; nothing under "observed" is inferred, and no file here is called correct, incorrect, admissible or refusable.

probed_producers.ogrinfo_format_parquet:
Format Details:
  Short Name: Parquet
  Long Name: (Geo)Parquet
  Supports: Vector
  Extension: parquet
  Help Topic: drivers/vector/parquet.html
  Supports: Open() - Open existing dataset.
  Supports: Create() - Create writable dataset.
  Supports: Virtual IO - eg. /vsimem/
  Creation Field Datatypes: Integer Integer64 Real String Date Time DateTime Binary IntegerList Integer64List RealList StringList
  Creation Field Data Sub-types: Boolean Int16 Float32 JSON UUID
  Supported SQL dialects: OGRSQL SQLITE

<LayerCreationOptionList>
  <Option name="COMPRESSION" type="string-select" description="Compression method" default="SNAPPY">
    <Value alias="UNCOMPRESSED">NONE</Value>
    <Value>SNAPPY</Value>
    <Value>GZIP</Value>
    <Value>BROTLI</Value>
    <Value>ZSTD</Value>
    <Value>LZ4_RAW</Value>
    <Value>LZ4_HADOOP</Value>
  </Option>
  <Option name="GEOMETRY_ENCODING" type="string-select" description="Encoding of geometry columns" default="WKB">
    <Value>WKB</Value>
    <Value>WKT</Value>
    <Value alias="GEOARROW_STRUCT">GEOARROW</Value>
    <Value>GEOARROW_INTERLEAVED</Value>
  </Option>
  <Option name="ROW_GROUP_SIZE" type="integer" description="Maximum number of rows per group" default="65536" />
  <Option name="GEOMETRY_NAME" type="string" description="Name of geometry column" default="geometry" />
  <Option name="COORDINATE_PRECISION" type="float" description="Number of decimals for coordinates (only for GEOMETRY_ENCODING=WKT)" />
  <Option name="FID" type="string" description="Name of the FID column to create" />
  <Option name="POLYGON_ORIENTATION" type="string-select" description="Which ring orientation to use for polygons" default="COUNTERCLOCKWISE">
    <Value>COUNTERCLOCKWISE</Value>
    <Value>UNMODIFIED</Value>
  </Option>
  <Option name="EDGES" type="string-select" description="Name of the coordinate system for the edges" default="PLANAR">
    <Value>PLANAR</Value>
    <Value>SPHERICAL</Value>
  </Option>
  <Option name="CREATOR" type="string" description="Name of creating application" />
  <Option name="WRITE_COVERING_BBOX" type="boolean" default="YES" description="Whether to write xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax columns with the bounding box of geometries" />
  <Option name="SORT_BY_BBOX" type="boolean" default="NO" description="Whether features should be sorted based on the bounding box of their geometries" />
</LayerCreationOptionList>

<OpenOptionList>
  <Option name="GEOM_POSSIBLE_NAMES" type="string" description="Comma separated list of possible names for geometry column(s)." default="geometry,wkb_geometry,wkt_geometry" />
  <Option name="CRS" type="string" description="Set/override CRS, typically defined as AUTH:CODE (e.g EPSG:4326), of geometry column(s)" />
</OpenOptionList>

  Other metadata items:
    ARROW_VERSION=19.0.1
    ARROW_DATASET=YES

observed_field_meanings.crs_shape: absent-key = the geometry column metadata carries no "crs" member; null = the member is present and is JSON null; projjson:<authority>:<code> or projjson:<name> = a PROJJSON object is present
observed_field_meanings.crs_axis_names: the PROJJSON crs's coordinate_system.axis[*].name list, in the order the file states it; null where crs is absent or null, or where the PROJJSON carries no top-level coordinate_system. For a ProjectedCRS this is the projected system's axis list; the base_crs axis list is deliberately not substituted
observed_field_meanings.crs_axis_directions: the same axis objects' "direction" values, same order, same null rule
observed_field_meanings.geo_creator: the geo metadata's own "creator" member, verbatim; null where the writer emitted none
observed_field_meanings.parquet_footer_created_by: the Parquet footer's created_by string, verbatim
observed_field_meanings.parquet_open_error: null when pyarrow opened the file; otherwise the exception text, verbatim. Only mutations are expected to be unopenable
observed_field_meanings.geo_metadata_parses_as_json: whether the raw value of the "geo" key-value metadata key parsed as JSON
observed_field_meanings.integer_typed_columns, string_typed_colu: columns whose Arrow type is an integer or a string type. Listed by name and type only. No column is called a key here; nothing was read from the column values.
observed_field_meanings.bbox_present_in_column_metadata: whether the geo metadata's geometry column object carries a "bbox" member; this is not a statement about Parquet column statistics
observed_field_meanings.observed_difference_from_base: mutations only: byte size, the uint32 footer-length field in the last eight bytes, the trailing PAR1 magic, and whether the geo metadata parses, for the base and for the mutation side by side

how_obtained.command_or_url: shutil.copy2 of the base, then one byte at absolute offset 9764 XORed with 0x01 in place (0xA2 -> 0xA3), then os.utime to put the base's mtime back. The offset is column chunk 3 ("geometry") of row group 0, at its first page offset 4211 plus half its compressed size 11107, i.e. inside the compressed page data and not in the footer.

how_obtained.command_or_url: pyarrow: t = pq.read_table(base); pq.ParquetWriter(dst, t.schema) with w.write_table(t) called twice, so the file carries the base's rows as row group 1 and the same rows again as row group 2. The schema key-value metadata, including geo, is the base's, carried through pq.read_table unchanged. This is a rewrite, not a byte append: a Parquet footer cannot be appended to in place.
